name: What is the difference between natural stone and manufactured stone veneer?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between natural stone and manufactured stone veneer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Natural stone is quarried, cut, and shaped, offering unique variations in color and texture, making each piece distinct. Manufactured stone veneer is a man-made product designed to replicate natural stone's appearance but is generally lighter and more uniform. A practical tradeoff to consider is the initial material cost versus long-term maintenance; natural stone can be more expensive upfront but often has a longer lifespan with proper care, while manufactured stone might offer a more budget-friendly aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Natural stone is quarried with unique variations; manufactured stone is man-made, lighter, and more uniform.
